message.content:
**Audit — Ratings card (Dr. Varun Malik, 390px viewport)**

1) **Visual consistency** — Yes. The Ratings card uses the same left/right margins (~16px), light border, and rounded corners as the Clinic hours card. Typography (bold section header "Ratings", card body text) matches the page's system. One minor nit: Clinic hours uses a filled light-gray surface while Ratings uses white with border — slightly different treatment, but not jarring.

2) **Rating summary clarity** — Good. The ★ icon + "4.0 · 1 review" reads unambiguously as a summary line. Icon and text are vertically aligned; bold weight gives appropriate emphasis. Note the screenshot uses a middot ("4.0 · 1 review") rather than the hyphen described in the spec — acceptable, arguably cleaner, but verify which separator is intended.

3) **Absence of sub-scores** — Clean. The card contains only the summary row with no dangling divider or awkward empty space; padding looks symmetric. The "1 visits · 0 patients on Aturseva" line below is a separate context line, not an orphaned sub-score, so it doesn't read as a missing-row artifact. Honest rendering, and it doesn't look broken.

4) **Overlap/misalignment** — None found. Star icon baseline aligns with text; card doesn't collide with the footer caption or the "Practices at" section. The partially visible "Practices at" card at the bottom edge is normal scroll truncation, not a defect. CTA bar doesn't overlap the ratings content.

5) **Tone** — Calm. Neutral grays, no alarm styling on the single-review state, no urgency cues or clutter.

**VERDICT: PASS** — Ratings card is consistent, honest (no fabricated sub-scores), well-aligned, and calm.
